newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers shed $1-2/T on weak cargo prices.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers shed $1-2/T on weak cargo prices.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices continued its downward trend amid thin demand as shipowners were relaxed waiting for prices to shed further losses, trades said on Thursday.
"Shipowners are confident that prices would ease further, said a major.
Bunker 180-cst and 380-cst were quoted at $111 and $118 per tonne respectively by majors. Independents were quoting even lower figures at $108-$109 for 380-cst.
MDO and gas oil eased to $220 and $235 from $225-$230 and $245-$248 a tonne respectively on similarly weakening cargoes.
